title: Iran War Sends Gold To Its Worst Month In 43 Years – Is This A Miners' Lehman Moment? - VanEck Gold Miners ETF (ARCA:GDX)
summary: Gold has plummeted 17% due to rising real yields and inflation expectations, contrary to the anticipated safe-haven trade during the Iran conflict. This has led to a significant sell-off in gold mining stocks, with the VanEck Gold Miners ETF experiencing its worst performance since the 2008 financial crisis.
sentiment_reason: The article describes a strong negative market impact due to gold's unexpected decline amidst geopolitical tensions, influenced by rising real yields and inflation expectations, leading to a major sell-off in gold and mining stocks.
